newsitem.title: CHINA: China defence minister meets Belarus counterpart.
newsitem.headline: China defence minister meets Belarus counterpart.

text.p: Chinese Minister of Defence Chi Haotian met his Belarus counterpart Leonid Maltsev in Beijing on Monday and said military relations between the two nations had reached a new level.
"The visit marks a new stage in the friendly relations of the two armed forces and is of great significance," the official Xinhua news agency quoted Chi as saying.
Maltsev's visit was the first trip to China by a Belarus defence minister since the ex-Soviet republic won its independence in 1991, Xinhua said.
"The Chinese armed forces are ready to develop all-round and all-faceted friendship and cooperation with their counterparts of Belarus," Chi said.
Xinhua quoted Maltsev as saying his visit was aimed at increasing friendship and cooperation between the two nations' armed forces.
China and the central Asian state of Tajikistan last week issued a joint declaration agreeing to strengthen military contacts and cooperation.
